questions.stem: The TROPIC OF CANCER passes through how many Indian STATES?
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer (23°26′ N) passes through 8 Indian states (west → east): Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram. India is thus roughly half in the tropics, half in subtropics.

questions.stem: The latitude passing through India roughly through the CENTRAL part is:
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer — 23.5° N — passes through the middle of India. Equator (0°) is south of India (closest point Indira Point in Nicobar at ~6°N). Tropic of Capricorn is south of equator; Arctic Circle (66.5° N) far north.

questions.stem: The INDIAN STANDARD TIME (IST) is based on the meridian at:
questions.explanation: IST = GMT + 5:30 hours, referenced to 82.5° E longitude (passes through Mirzapur / Naini near Allahabad, UP). This 'standard meridian' gives a single national time. India is ~30° wide east-west so single time zone causes sun-time differences of ~2 hours end-to-end. passing through Mirzapur, UP.

questions.stem: The EQUATOR divides the Earth into:
questions.explanation: Equator (0° latitude) — divides Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres. The Prime Meridian (0° longitude through Greenwich) + International Date Line (~180°) divide Eastern and Western hemispheres. Equator is ~40,075 km long.

questions.stem: The WORLD has how many STANDARD TIME ZONES?
questions.explanation: 24 main time zones (360°/15° each = 24, since Earth rotates 360° in 24 hr → 15°/hour). Some countries use half-hour / 45-min offsets (India = +5:30; Nepal = +5:45; Iran = +3:30). Russia: 11 zones. China: single zone despite wide longitude.

questions.stem: The INTERNATIONAL DATE LINE is approximately along:
questions.explanation: IDL — roughly 180° meridian, zig-zagging to keep island groups and countries on the same calendar date (Kiribati line, Chukotka). Cross IDL going east → lose a day. Going west → gain a day. with kinks to avoid splitting countries.

questions.stem: India's SOUTHERNMOST point (mainland) is CAPE COMORIN / KANYAKUMARI. The southernmost point of India's TERRITORY is:
questions.explanation: Indira Point (Great Nicobar) — 6°45′ N — southernmost point of Indian territory. Was called 'Pygmalion Point' earlier; renamed in honour of Indira Gandhi. Submerged permanently by 2004 tsunami. Kanyakumari is southernmost point of MAINLAND (8°4′ N).
